settings.heading: Deposit & refunds
settings.intro: How to cancel a reservation, and how refunds work.
settings.fallback_content:
What the deposit does

It reserves your size in the current production allocation. It is fully refundable at any time before your mattress is dispatched.

How to cancel

Email or WhatsApp us with your order number. No forms designed to slow you down.

Timing & method

Refunds return to the original payment method within 5–10 business days of cancellation confirmation.

Balance

The balance is only due once we confirm your dispatch date. You will never be chased for the balance before that confirmation.

Who to contact

Use the email or WhatsApp on our contact page. We reply within one working day.
